question: What will the first reported revenues after September 2026 be for the following companies? (AMD)

calls.reasoning: AMD guided Q3 2026 revenue to $13.0B ±$0.3B (Aug 4, 2026); reports Nov 3, 2026. Reference class: AMD actual revenue vs guidance midpoint—recent beats of ~3% (Q2'26: 11.536 vs 11.2) to ~6-7% (late 2025, recalled from memory, not verified this run). Consensus cited at ~$13.19B by one source and ~$12.97B by Investing.com; previews say analysts expect a beat. Median ~$13.4B (≈+3%). Downside below the $12.7B low end of guidance is rare for AMD lately; going above $14.2B would need a >9% beat (~1%). No Polymarket/Kalshi/Manifold/bookmaker market found.
calls.dossier:
- AMD Q3 2026 guidance (Q2 PR, Aug 4 2026, ir.amd.com): revenue ~$13.0B ±$0.3B (range $12.7-13.3B), ~41% YoY, ~13% QoQ; non-GAAP GM ~56%.
- Q2 2026 actual (same PR): $11.536B (+50% YoY, +13% QoQ); Data Center $6.718B (+107% YoY), Client $3.062B, Gaming $0.779B (-31% YoY), Embedded $0.977B.
- Q2 2026 guidance given in May 2026 (Q1 8-K, sec.gov): $11.2B ±$0.3B -> actual beat midpoint by ~3.0%.
- Earlier pattern (recalled, not re-verified this run): Q3 2025 guide $8.7B vs actual ~$9.25B; Q4 2025 guide $9.6B vs actual ~$10.27B (beats ~6-7%).
- Reporting date: Nov 3, 2026 after market close (stocktitan/AMD announcement); one site says Nov 2.
- Consensus figures vary by provider (Oct 2026 search summaries): one source cites ~$13.19B; Investing.com ~$12.97B; MarketBeat ~$12.4B (likely stale, below guidance range). Benzinga Oct 2026 preview headline: analyst expects 'beat-and-raise'.
- Downside risks: gaming decline, export-control issues for China-bound GPUs, MI-series timing of shipments. Upside: data-center GPU/EPYC demand, client share gains.
- Status quo: AMD has met or beaten the guidance midpoint in recent quarters; no misses below the low end of guidance found for 2025-2026.
- Resolves off AMD's reported Q3 FY2026 total GAAP revenue (first report after Sept 2026), not the consensus figures.
- Event window: the Q3 FY2026 quarter (ends late Sept 2026); the report on Nov 3 is the first after Sept 2026. As of Oct 7 the quarter has ended; the report is pending.
- Searched for Polymarket/Kalshi/Manifold markets on AMD Q3 revenue: none found.

calls.reconciliation: All three runs agree on the guidance ($13.0B ± $0.3B), the Q2 actual ($11.536B) and a consensus of about $13.0B to $13.2B. The factual disputes don't matter here: whether the report comes Nov 2 or Nov 3 doesn't change the number, and the late-2025 beat sizes were from memory in all runs but consistent with each other. Run 3's itemized history (mean beat about +$0.36B, recent beats $0.34B to $0.45B) supports a median of about $13.35B to $13.42B, so I chose $13.38B. On width, Runs 1 and 2 (0.7 to 0.8B) and Run 3 (0.56B) differ only in judgment. The spread of past beats implies about 0.57B before allowing for a miss, so I took about 0.68B. I had no web access on this run, so I retrieved nothing myself.
